assumptions: The names in the 'already happens on base' section of design.md (validate_session, _whoami_lookup, createLogoutHandler, the express-session options and so on) match the repository; I could not check them.
The criterion ids (C-xxxxxxxx) are generated at intake as the tasks describe.
The L4 gates really exclude e2e/** as design.md says, so the Playwright files are not needed for the gate to pass.

findings.text: readCookie is specified for a repeated name as 'the first occurrence' and as undefined when the value is empty. It does not say what happens when the first occurrence is empty and a later one is not. An implementer has to pick one, and the tests in task 4.1 do not pin it.

POST /admin/logout runs behind the logout rate limiter. The spec does not say what a rate-limited operator sees, or whether logout may be refused with 429 (the limiter's own answer). The router test only counts limiter calls. This is a small gap.

When admin-api answers 503, the admin-ui redirects to /admin/login as if logout succeeded. design.md lists this under Risks as a deferred follow-up, so the behaviour is stated and testable (scenario 'admin-api is unreachable or refuses'). The operator is told nothing about a session that may still be valid.
